title: Juicy Smoky Dutch Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring tender lamb, smoky spices, and couscous, perfect for a comforting meal. This dish is low in carbs and can be a great hangover cure.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened and translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, and browned lamb back to the pot, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
About 30 minutes before serving, prepare the couscous according to the package instructions.
Fluff the cooked couscous with a fork and serve with the lamb stew.
